gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-nabataean: Expose sets its capitals barely above its lowercase, packed tight and nearly breathless. Noto Sans Nabataean, a contemporary sans-serif, has tall lowercase and wide curves on its s, so paragraphs of it keep moving without strain.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-old-turkic: Almost no gap separates the lowercase from the capitals in Expose, giving the display lines a compressed, refined punch. Noto Sans Old Turkic is chunky, tall and sans-serif, its curves staying clear and open.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-runic: Striking is the right word for Expose, with its tightly packed lines. Noto Sans Runic sits below in a modern sans-serif, its tall lowercase leaving little ascender room and its curves left open, so the display text gets the drama and the body gets out of its way.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-saurashtra: Noto Sans Saurashtra is a clean sans-serif whose capitals barely rise above their neighbors. And its counters stay linked to the outside, so a long page of it moves along without any snagging.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-soyombo: Expose packs capitals and lowercase almost to one height. Noto Sans Soyombo, a contemporary sans-serif with a sizable x-height and curves left wide open at the mouth, stays comfortable and easy to follow across many paragraphs on a screen.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-sundanese: Noto Sans Sundanese reads clean and plain, its sans-serif letters almost level in height with open-mouthed crossbars on the e. Expose does its best work large and brief, where its compressed refinement can land.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Approachable comes through in Noto Sans Tangsa, with round letters opening wide and short ascender stems on tall lowercase bodies. Expose belongs in big, brief lines, where its tight, compressed cadence can make an impression.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-thai: Noto Sans Thai has lowercase swollen like inflated glass beads. Expose stays compressed and refined above it, and the plain sans body, with its rounded letters left open, keeps a long stretch of reading friendly.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-thai-looped: Tall, bold-looking lowercase with spacious curve gaps gives the text a clean voice. Noto Sans Thai Looped carries that sans body, while Expose belongs in big, short lines where its striking compression can show.
gen-fs-expose-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Expose crushes the gap between lowercase and capitals into a striking, refined tightness. And Noto Sans Ugaritic, with its open letter mouths like a chalk arc left unjoined, keeps longer passages friendly and clean.
